description: This file defines a React hook 'useFinanceSummary' that fetches and normalizes financial summary data from an API endpoint. It includes a helper function 'normalizeFinanceSummary' to sanitize and shape the payload for UI rendering.

methods.name: normalizeFinanceSummary(payload)
methods.description: Normalizes raw financial payload data into a stable, UI-friendly format, providing default values and ensuring shape consistency even if backend data is missing.

methods.name: useFinanceSummary()
methods.description: React hook that fetches financial summary data from '/finance/summary', normalizes the data, and returns it along with loading, error, refetch, and URL info.
